darkForestBorrowing.contents: canon-open entire — what the dread IS and what stopped moving are the owner's, possibly forever; this grammar writes no word of it
darkForestBorrowing.fence: the grammar may stage the dread; it may never stage an EXPLANATION of it (shared with #138)
darkForestBorrowing.game: the depths keep their withholding entire (empty tables #7, empty plate #128); only surface edge-moments stage, from the beds that already hold them
darkForestBorrowing.grammar: the depths' dread register stages in this family's grammar: things done in an old way, properly, by no one visible

discipline: custom is never decoration — a ritual shape as garnish on a non-yokai performance is a defect
the form itself is never the joke — comedy lives in witnesses, never in the ceremony
battle tempo compresses the propriety beats but never deletes them
identity: power staged as etiquette — a spirit's spectacle is ritual-shaped, done in the old way, in the proper order; the wonder and the terror both come from how CORRECT it is
objects: the frame fills with things, not effect layers — masks, bells, paper, rope, flame in a row, water in a vessel: ordinary sacred objects, correctly used; power shows in what they do when the ritual reaches them

registers.dread: the same form kept in an empty place, at the wrong hour, perfectly — correctness itself is the frightening part; carried by place, hour (#19), and witness, never by sloppiness
registers.wonder: the festival register — colour, ceremonial music (#72), a community witnessing; spectacle as belonging

ritualShape: opening propriety — arrival acknowledged, a greeting-shape, a threshold respected
the working — gestures in their inherited order, visibly practised, never improvised
closing propriety — a skipped step is itself a staging event: the audience FEELS the omission (the family's alarm cue)
